recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition featuring a close-up portrait of a woman with short, curly blonde hair leaning against a heavily textured tree trunk. The left side of the frame is reserved for a dense block of centered, multi-tiered typography set against a pale, overcast sky and a blurred background of a wrought-iron fence.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against the central vertical axis of a tree trunk
Text block balanced against the visual weight of the subject's head
Muted earth tones in clothing and nature contrasting with primary blue and red text accents
Soft, diffused outdoor lighting creating gentle shadows on the face
coreInvariants: Textured tree bark as a central vertical divider
Centered typographic alignment in the upper-left quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, positioned in the middle-ground leaning forward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's face and the rough texture of the tree bark serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold blue text at the top left, moves down the list of secondary text, then follows the diagonal line of the tree trunk to the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the top left corner, filled with a pale, hazy sky to accommodate text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted beige and tan (clothing and skin tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep brown and charcoal (tree bark and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Royal blue and bright red (primary text and small graphic icons)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value backgrounds, allowing the high-contrast blue text to pop.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to earth tones and primary accents

letterConstructionRules: Thick vertical stems with thin horizontal hairlines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic serif family with color-coded hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rules with decorative diamond and heart motifs
Small square logo in bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, sturdy serif look of the era.
Provides the extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1970s-style outdoor portrait of a woman with short curly blonde hair wearing a beige coat, leaning against a thick, gnarled tree trunk. The background shows a blurred wrought-iron fence and a pale, overcast sky. Muted, desaturated film aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered, all-caps serif text in the upper left quadrant. Use royal blue for the top two lines and bright red for the third line. Separate the blue and red text with a thin blue horizontal line featuring a small red heart in the center. Add a list of smaller blue serif text below.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered in the upper-left negative space?
Is the tree trunk providing a clear vertical texture?
Are the colors for the text strictly blue and red?
Is the overall lighting soft and diffused?

mustAchieve: Authentic 1970s film grain and color grading

postGenerationChecks: Verify the text does not overlap the subject's face
Ensure the red heart icon is centered on the rule line
Check that the background fence is sufficiently out of focus
Confirm the serif font has high stroke contrast
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured vertical nature element with a soft-focus portrait and a high-contrast, multi-colored serif typographic block in the negative space.
